items.html: And indeed, in the coupling of Tifferet and Malchut, the 320 sparks that are in Malchut are in a different manner, for they are alluded to in the name Adonai, through which she becomes heated and couples with Zeir Anpin. The matter is that in the name Adonai, if you remove the letter Alef, Din [judgment] remains. And behold, the five Gevurot are the root of all judgments; therefore, when the 320 sparks are divided into five phases, they become five times Din, to allude that they are truly judgments.
